mainEntity.name: What materials are best for playroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: For playroom flooring, popular and durable options include luxury vinyl plank (LVP), engineered hardwood, or high-quality carpet. LVP offers excellent durability and easy cleaning, ideal for spills, while carpet provides softness and sound absorption. The decision factor often comes down to balancing durability, comfort, and maintenance needs, especially in high-traffic areas. For families in San Leandro or Union City, considering a resilient, low-maintenance option that can withstand active play and spills is often prioritized. We can discuss the pros and cons of each during design.
